question: Should this repository adopt the canonical OpenClaw pull request template exactly as proposed?
rationale: The implementation is correct, but adopting repository-wide contributor instructions is a governance choice and the PR is member-authored, so ClawSweeper should not resolve it automatically.

options.title: Adopt canonical template
options.body: Merge the exact canonical template to standardize pull request descriptions across the OpenClaw repositories.

options.title: Request local adjustments
options.body: Keep the PR open and identify any clawdinators-specific submission instructions that should differ before merging.

recommendation.title: Adopt canonical template
recommendation.body: Merge the exact canonical template to standardize pull request descriptions across the OpenClaw repositories.
